pdc.title: The PDC model
pdc.description: Predict, detect, correct. De-Trap's own guidebook framework for talking about risk, not a validated academic instrument. Drag the dial to see how answers move someone between zones.
pdc.disclaimer: This is a De-Trap teaching tool built for workshops, not a clinical or academic diagnostic. Treat the zone as a conversation starter, not a verdict.
pdc.predictBody: Spot the conditions that make borrowing likely before money changes hands: no savings buffer, pressure to keep up, unclear costs.
pdc.detectBody: Notice the signs once borrowing has started: missed dates, hidden apps, borrowing to repay.
pdc.correctBody: The concrete next step for each zone, from a checklist to telling one adult.

about.title: About De-Trap
about.description: De-Trap Initiative is a student-led research and outreach project. We read the terms and conditions so our peers don't have to learn the hard way.
about.missionBody: Nobody gets trapped by a loan they understood. We exist to close the gap between what these products advertise and what they actually cost.
